discovered_defect.description: The database is current through 2026-08-14 but most stocks lack sufficient pre-2025 history; only three main-board symbols formed 60-bar features on the registered historical start day.

corrected_data_sources.historical_database_coverage: 2022-11-21 through 2026-07-13; about 2.33 million daily bars and roughly 3,000 symbols per registered historical day
corrected_data_sources.merge_rule: merge by symbol and trading day; recent overlay wins on duplicate keys
